headline: Iran Facing Severe Winter Natural Gas Deficits Following War Damage
summary: Iranian President Masud Pezeshkian warned the country faces natural gas supply problems this winter. War damage to key processing facilities has worsened pre-existing energy imbalances across Iran.
why: Iran holds the world's second-largest natural gas reserves, and its domestic fuel shortages impact regional energy distribution and power generation.

impacts.name: Iran Energy Sector
impacts.why: Infrastructure damage from armed conflict reduced domestic natural gas processing capability.
